race.description: Tab Beaudesert Cup 21 Nov Mdn Hcp
race.comment: STAR OF PARIS (2) wasn't far off maiden success before a lengthy break, finishing the campaign with a minor placing over 1300m at Newcastle. Revved up for this with three solid trials. Rates highly on best figures and should be right in this contest from the inside alley. SPOILT ROTTEN (9) wasn't disgraced at his last run before going for a spell on May 4, finishing fourth and beaten 4.5 lengths over 1200m at Ipswich. Generally runs well first-up with two minor placings from three tries and makes plenty of appeal while fresh. NO WALLET REG (8) finished fifth over 1200m at Ipswich when resuming last start, beaten only 1.75 lengths after being prominent at the bend. Tackling a more suitable race so he can turn things around. MYSTIC MEADOW (4) is facing the starter for the first time and any market confidence must be noted.
